models.xg2: xG v2 season-start model: trained on seasons < S only, scores all of S
models.xg2_asof: xG v2 with monthly as-of refits: block [m, m+1) scored by a model trained on seasons < S plus S games before m (weight cur_weight)
models.xg1_pit: incumbent v1 recipe re-fit on seasons [S-window, S-1] (the M1 bar)
models.xg1_prod: committed xg_model_xgb.pkl with the production empty-net override (in sample on 2022-26)

main.definition: unblocked non-shootout attempts, excl. empty net and penalty shots, with coordinates

all.definition: every unblocked non-shootout attempt with coordinates (v1 prod: EN override 0.52)

gate.note_b: the literal [0.97, 1.03] band is narrower than one season's sampling error for the small strengths (3v3, 4v5, EN: ~100-250 goals, SE ~6-10%); 'consistent' asks whether the 95% Poisson CI of goals/xG overlaps the band
